# alpine:3.20
FROM docker.example.test/library/alpine@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa AS certs
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates=20250911-r0

# golang:1.27-alpine
FROM registry.example.test/library/golang@sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb AS base
WORKDIR /src

FROM base AS ci
RUN apk add --no-cache curl=8.14.1-r1

FROM base AS builder
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /out/service .

# alpine:3.20
FROM registry.example.test/library/alpine@sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
COPY --from=builder /out/service /service
USER 65532:65532
ENTRYPOINT ["/service"]
